messages.subject: Re: Having trouble running secr with data spanning more than 5 occasions
parts:
Nicholas
The error message is explicit: "fewer usage fields than max(occasion)". Your detector file has 5 usage fields; if usage fields are provided then their number determines the number of occasions. Five usage fields is therefore incompatible with a capture on occasion 6, and the error check is doing its job. As all your usage codes are '1' they are not needed and could be deleted from the detector file.
Murray

On Wed, Aug 24, 2016 at 3:17 PM, njf009 <njf...@student.usc.edu.au> wrote:
Hi all,

I cannot seem to work around an error when I try to run secr with more than 5 occasions. I've attached a detector input, a (working) capture input, and a modified version of this capture input with the last detection modified to be on the 6th occasion. It has been suggested that I have problem with my input data, so I modified data that has previously worked. Has anyone had this problem before? 

Thanks so much for your time,
Nicholas Foster
